_schema: LEGEND governance v3.1.1 · Annex A.1 TASK_ASSIGNMENT
_note: Part of the ten-hour repurposing batch ORCH-REPURPOSING-10H-20261021. Adjacent and transferable literature: every paper that is not WWOX evidence is labelled NOT WWOX EVIDENCE, at class level, no dose, no paediatric suitability presumed, not medical advice.
OBJECTIVE: Roadmap P5, drafted from the audited and repaired cards: present TWO comparisons, one per path (deep recovery, early benefit), as VISIBLE DIMENSIONS (benefit, evidence, risk, time to access, time to benefit, feasibility) with UNKNOWN kept as UNKNOWN (never zero, never favourable); identify the NON-DOMINATED candidates per path as a statement about those visible dimensions; compare with the plain target-to-drug lookup and with the pre-existing records; state what changes in the choice of the next experiment. NO score, NO rank, NO probability, NO blended index, NO dose, NO paediatric suitability.

inputs: the cards' notes and the roadmap P5 section quoted in drug_repurposing/roadmap_v4_r14_20261020.md
SCOPE.outputs: disease-models/wwox/research/drug_repurposing/p5/ (new, yours alone) with a README; do NOT edit cards/ or cards_early/

ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA: a table per path with the visible dimensions as columns and every candidate AND abstention as rows, cells carrying the card's own field value or UNKNOWN
non-dominated set per path stated with the dominance relation spelled out pair by pair for the pairs that decide it
a convergence note that separates agreeing ALGORITHMS from independent ORIGINS of evidence (shared sources count once)
what the simple target-to-drug lookup would have chosen and whether the cards change it
the single measurement that would most change which candidate deserves discussion with a treating team, phrased as a question
DELIVERABLE: manifests, staged receipt JSONs, commit candidates, analysis note, self-eval

TASK_ACK.understanding: Roadmap P5: two separate visible-dimension tables (deep recovery 12 rows, early benefit 9 rows, abstentions as rows), UNKNOWN kept UNKNOWN, non-dominated sets stated pair by pair over evaluable dimensions only, convergence split into algorithms vs origins, comparison with the Monarch/DGIdb thin slice and pre-existing records, statement of what changes in the next-experiment choice. No score, rank, probability, blended index, dose, route, schedule or paediatric suitability; no paper is read.

TASK_CLAIM.note: No paper is read; no reading claim, no receipt. Outputs only under disease-models/wwox/research/drug_repurposing/p5/ and the note repurposing_10h_scientist-a_p5_20261022.md; cards/, cards_early/, roadmap copies and repurposing_bridge.py are not touched.
